policy: Frozen T00 thresholds unchanged. KEEP here denotes correctness repair, not a speedup promotion.
transfer_decision: Quantized/MoE/FP8/approximate attention paths do not reproduce this dense BF16 eager graph. Reuse existing numeric operations, resource groups, bounded cache and explicit admission.

experiments.name: codec-color-reference
experiments.decision: Honor source matrix/range. PyAV16/FFmpeg8 conversion shortcuts/rounding are unsuitable as a golden for the pinned FFmpeg7 C profile. Compare to its separate public swscale API without widening pixel equality.
